messages.subject: online C++ optimization book
parts:
As a parting gift, Matt left us with a link:

http://www.agner.org/optimize/optimizing_cpp.pdf

I'm about halfway through (it's only 150pps) and it's
been really helpful in clarifying what's going on in the
compiler and the CPU. Especially w.r.t. things like branch
prediction and opportunistic evaluations in the CPU.

There are also sister volumes on assembly and the
various CPUs.

- Bob
